q1.q: Be honest: why are you really thinking about leaving?
q1.a: I want energy and culture — bold art, buzzing streets, a city that never runs out of things to show me
q1.b: I want to slow all the way down — warm water, salt air, absolutely nowhere to be
q1.c: I want space and silence — somewhere quiet enough to hear myself think again
q1.d: I want to feel more connected — to people, place, and daily life

q2.q: You've just arrived in a new city. What do you do first?
q2.a: Head straight into the busiest market or neighbourhood and let the energy pull me in
q2.b: Find the water, kick off my shoes, and just breathe
q2.c: Look for the nearest trail, forest, or quiet edge of town
q2.d: Find whoever's lived here the longest and ask them to show me around

q3.q: A friend asks what you're looking for abroad. You say...
q3.a: Somewhere alive — culture, art, a scene I can actually be part of
q3.b: Somewhere I can finally exhale — slow mornings, warm water, no rush
q3.c: Somewhere quiet and wild, where the landscape does most of the talking
q3.d: Somewhere I can actually belong. A real neighbourhood, real relationships

q4.q: What would make you feel like you'd truly made it abroad?
q4.a: I know the best hole-in-the-wall spots, and half the neighbourhood recognises me on the street
q4.b: I've stopped checking the time. The days blur together in the best way
q4.c: I've found my own quiet trail, my own view, my own sanctuary
q4.d: The café owner knows my order. I have a regular table. People know my name

q5.q: What's the thing you're most willing to give up to live abroad?
q5.a: Predictability — I want something unexpected around every corner
q5.b: Ambition, for a while — I'd trade the hustle for ease without hesitation
q5.c: Convenience — I'll live somewhere remote if it means real peace and quiet
q5.d: Comfort and familiarity — if it means more warmth and connection somewhere new

q6.q: You're having a hard week abroad — homesick, frustrated, nothing's working. What gets you through?
q6.a: I go find something happening — a market, a show, anything with energy
q6.b: I get in the water or watch the sunset. It resets everything
q6.c: I go for a long walk somewhere quiet and let my head clear
q6.d: A neighbour brings food. Someone checks in. The community I've built shows up

q7.q: What's your relationship with language barriers?
q7.a: Half the fun is piecing it together on the fly, mid-market, mid-conversation
q7.b: I don't overthink it — a smile and slow living go a long way
q7.c: I don't need much language where I'm headed. It's mostly just me and the landscape
q7.d: I'll learn the language. That's part of belonging — you meet people halfway

q8.q: Someone asks how long you're planning to stay. You say...
q8.a: As long as it stays interesting. Could be a year, could be a decade
q8.b: Indefinitely, if the sun keeps setting over water like this
q8.c: As long as the quiet holds
q8.d: Indefinitely. If it becomes home, why leave?

q9.q: Which of these would make you fall in love with a destination?
q9.a: Stumbling onto a street party and being pulled into a stranger's home for dinner
q9.b: A hammock, warm water, and absolutely nowhere to be
q9.c: Turning a corner and finding a view so big it stops me cold
q9.d: Reading that three people I respect have quietly put down roots here in the last two years

q10.q: Ten years from now, the version of you that made the right choice abroad...
q10.a: Still finds something new around every corner. Never bored, always curious
q10.b: Lives somewhere the ocean is part of daily life. Slower, lighter, unbothered
q10.c: Has a view they never get tired of, and a quiet life built around it
q10.d: Has a village. Close friends, rituals, a life that feels genuinely inhabited

urban.name: Urban Explorer
urban.description: You're a culture sponge. You thrive in dynamic places where the espresso is strong, the art is bold, and the possibilities feel endless. Think: bustling markets, late-night jazz clubs, walkable streets, and ten different languages in earshot. You're fuelled by curiosity, connection, and the thrill of being part of something.
urban.youllLove: Barcelona, Tokyo, Lisbon, Buenos Aires, Mexico City

coastal.name: Coastal Dreamer
coastal.description: Slow mornings. Salt on your skin. A deep need to exhale. You belong somewhere where the water is clear, the days are long, and shoes are optional. You're not trying to impress anyone — you're here to unwind, connect, and maybe learn how to surf or nap like a pro.
coastal.youllLove: Koh Phangan, Bali, Canary Islands, Tulum, Zanzibar

nature.name: Nature Seeker
nature.description: Solitude is sacred, and nature is your sanctuary. You don't mind getting your hands dirty or taking the long way around if it means peace, quiet, and epic views. You're probably a deep thinker, a good listener, and maybe even a little bit mystical.
nature.youllLove: Chiang Mai, San Cristóbal de las Casas, the Pyrenees, Oaxaca's highlands, the Dolomites

rooted.name: Rooted Romantic
rooted.description: You're all about meaningful simplicity. You value community, connection, and daily life that's grounded and slow. You don't mind hard work — especially when it's in service of something real, like growing food, raising kids, or putting down roots.
rooted.youllLove: Rural France, Southern Spain, Central Portugal, Northern Thailand, Sicily's countryside
